items.title: Smelloff, my startup
items.summary: My startup. Its first product is ODORSTRIKE, a pocket spray for clothes. I do most of the work myself: the product, the packaging, the website, the shipping and the customer inbox.
items.body: I started it with my friend Vineeth Kumar Duggepogu. We met at a job interview in Hyderabad and later worked together at Zomato Everyday.
